tool_schemas.name: drawing_generateCanvas
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new blank canvas with the requested pixel dimensions and returns the new canvas identifier (and its initial operation sequence/state). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if width/height are missing, non-numeric, non-integer, or not positive, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if canvas creation is throttled or over your allowed limits. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if your credentials are missing/invalid.

width.description: Width of the canvas in pixels

height.description: Height of the canvas in pixels

tool_schemas.name: drawing_fillRectangle
tool_schemas.description: Appends a "fill rectangle" operation to the current canvas’s append-only operation log and returns the recorded operation (including its sequence number) as the new latest state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if x/y/width/height/color are missing or out of range (width/height must be positive; r/g/b/a must be 0–255), and NOT_FOUND if there is no active canvas to apply the operation to. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if your credentials are missing/invalid and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if operation writes are rate-limited or exceed your plan limits.

x.description: X coordinate of the top-left corner of the rectangle

y.description: Y coordinate of the top-left corner of the rectangle

color.description: Color to fill the rectangle with (RGB)

tool_schemas.name: drawing_getCanvasPng
tool_schemas.description: Returns a base64-encoded PNG render of the canvas at opSeq (or the latest if omitted), optionally including render metadata when includeMeta is true; this endpoint does not page results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if canvasId/sessionId formats are invalid, opSeq/timeoutMs are negative, or required identifiers are missing, and NOT_FOUND if the canvas does not exist or the requested opSeq is beyond the available operation history. If waitForReady is true, raises TIMEOUT if the render is not ready within timeoutMs; raises UNAUTHORIZED if your credentials are missing/invalid and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if read/render requests are rate-limited.

canvasId.description: Canvas ULID to fetch the latest rendered PNG for

opSeq.description: Optional operation sequence number to fetch a PNG render at a specific applied operation; defaults to the latest

waitForReady.description: Whether to wait for the render to be ready (if currently building) before returning

includeMeta.description: Whether to include render metadata (e.g., render id, op_seq, sha256) alongside the PNG base64

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait when waitForReady is true

sessionId.description: (Deprecated/optional) Session ULID; if provided, the tool uses the session's active canvas when canvasId is omitted

tool_schemas.name: drawing_getCanvasData
tool_schemas.description: Returns the canvas pixel data as JSON at opSeq (or the latest if omitted), optionally including render metadata when includeMeta is true; this endpoint does not page results. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if canvasId/sessionId formats are invalid, opSeq/timeoutMs are negative, or required identifiers are missing, and NOT_FOUND if the canvas does not exist or the requested opSeq is beyond the available operation history. If waitForReady is true, raises TIMEOUT if the pixel snapshot is not ready within timeoutMs; raises UNAUTHORIZED if your credentials are missing/invalid and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if read/render requests are rate-limited.

canvasId.description: Canvas ULID to fetch the latest pixel data for

opSeq.description: Optional operation sequence number to fetch pixel data at a specific applied operation; defaults to the latest

waitForReady.description: Whether to wait for the render to be ready (if currently building) before returning

includeMeta.description: Whether to include render metadata (e.g., render id, op_seq, sha256) alongside the pixel JSON

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait when waitForReady is true

sessionId.description: (Deprecated/optional) Session ULID; if provided, the tool uses the session's active canvas when canvasId is omitted

tool_schemas.name: drawing_listCanvases
tool_schemas.description: Lists canvases visible to the caller, optionally filtered by session and status, returning a paginated result set ordered by most recently updated first. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters/pagination, and UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid.

sessionId.description: Optional session ULID to filter canvases by owning session.

limit.description: Maximum number of canvases to return (default 50, max 200).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: drawing_getCanvas
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single canvas record by id (metadata only), including its current operation sequence and current_render_id pointer. Raises NOT_FOUND if the canvas does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR if the id format is invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid.

tool_schemas.name: drawing_listCanvasOperations
tool_schemas.description: Lists the append-only operation log for a canvas in ascending sequence order (or by id), returning a paginated result set. Raises NOT_FOUND if the canvas does not exist, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid pagination or id formats, and UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid.

canvasId.description: Canvas ULID whose operations will be listed.

fromSeq.description: Optional inclusive lower bound on operation sequence number.

toSeq.description: Optional inclusive upper bound on operation sequence number.

limit.description: Maximum number of operations to return (default 100, max 500).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: drawing_closeCanvasSession
tool_schemas.description: Closes an active canvas session so no further operations can be applied via that session’s active canvas selection. Returns the updated session record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the session does not exist, CONFLICT if the session is already closed, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid id format, and UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid.

tool_schemas.name: drawing_archiveCanvas
tool_schemas.description: Archives a canvas, transitioning it to status='archived' so it is immutable for further drawing operations; existing renders remain retrievable. Returns the updated canvas record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the canvas does not exist, CONFLICT if the canvas is already archived, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid id format, and UNAUTHORIZED if credentials are missing/invalid.

metadata.name: Drawing Tool for AI Assistants
metadata.description: This backend stores drawing canvases and the operations applied to them (e.g., filling rectangles) so the current canvas state can be retrieved either as raw pixel JSON or rendered PNG (base64). The main workflow is: create a canvas, apply one or more drawing operations, then read the latest canvas
